name: x-mcp
description: A read-only X/Twitter MCP server that enables data retrieval for user profiles, tweets, and social graphs using OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token authentication. It supports searching recent tweets, viewing timelines, and tracking engagement metrics like followers, likes, and retweets.
